Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grills replaces a similar model of Weber gas grill that was about 20 years old.  It features several improvements: starts easily; flame adjusts readily and smoothly; heating seems more even in part because the burners run front to back, not side to side; two side tables are convenient. The cooking space under the hood is somewhat lower and that contributes to even heating, I believe.  The grills bars are relatively close together, and that's valuable in minimizing food dropping through the grid.  I assembled it myself with guidance in the paper manual and the videos in the app.
Results.Title: A Modern Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: I think Weber is the best brand on the market. I've owned several Weber charcoal grills in my lifetime but this is my first Weber gas grill, would never consider anything but Weber. The only reason I got rid of my previous Weber's was to upgrade to a more advanced model. I decided to go with a gas grill simply for convenience. While I don't get the same charcoal flavor, a smoker box goes a long way to solving that problem. It heats evenly, no apparent hot or cold spots. It starts and cleans easily. There is easy access to the propane tank and I love the duel shelves on the sides and the lower shelf. I expect this grill to last many years like my other Weber products.
Results.Title: My 3rd grill from Weber and I love it

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
